previous_statement: Validation-gated derivation. This step requires node 1.3.2.1 to be validated; until then it supplies no unconditional conclusion. Once 1.3.2.1 is validated, fix n and let b_n=sup_{X nonzero} ||gamma_n(X)||/||X||. It supplies both b_n<=5 and ||gamma_n(X^dagger X)-gamma_n(X)^dagger gamma_n(X)||<=D e||X||^2. For nonzero X, the target lower C*-inequality, the triangle inequality, the definition of b_n, and the exact source C*-identity give (1-epsilon)||gamma_n(X)||^2<=||gamma_n(X)^dagger gamma_n(X)||<=||gamma_n(X^dagger X)||+D e||X||^2<=(b_n+D e)||X||^2. Taking the supremum of the squared ratio yields (1-epsilon)b_n^2<=b_n+D e. Rearranging gives b_n(b_n-1)<=epsilon b_n^2+D e. If b_n<=1 the desired upper bound is immediate. If b_n>1, then epsilon<=e and b_n<=5 imply b_n(b_n-1)<=(25+D)e, and division by b_n>=1 gives b_n-1<=(25+D)e. Thus b_n<=1+(25+D)e, conditionally on validation of 1.3.2.1.
new_statement: Small-defect upper bootstrap, conditional on the validated bridge. Require node 1.3.2.1 to be validated, define e_bridge:=min{1,e_hom,e_mod} as in that node, and assume e:=rho+epsilon<e_bridge. Fix n and let b_n:=sup_{X nonzero} ||gamma_n(X)||/||X||. Under precisely this small-defect hypothesis, node 1.3.2.1 supplies b_n<=5 and ||gamma_n(X^dagger X)-gamma_n(X)^dagger gamma_n(X)||<=D e||X||^2. For nonzero X, the target lower C*-inequality, the triangle inequality, the definition of b_n, and the exact source C*-identity give (1-epsilon)||gamma_n(X)||^2<=||gamma_n(X)^dagger gamma_n(X)||<=||gamma_n(X^dagger X)||+D e||X||^2<=(b_n+D e)||X||^2. Taking the supremum yields (1-epsilon)b_n^2<=b_n+D e, hence b_n(b_n-1)<=epsilon b_n^2+D e. If b_n<=1, then b_n<=1+(25+D)e since e>=0. If b_n>1, epsilon<=e and b_n<=5 give b_n(b_n-1)<=(25+D)e; division by b_n>=1 gives b_n-1<=(25+D)e. Therefore b_n<=1+(25+D)e whenever e<e_bridge, conditionally on validation of node 1.3.2.1.
